narrative: An unfamiliar recruiter offers an exclusive research stipend.

message.body: Congratulations! Your profile was nominated for a ₹25,000 summer research micro-grant. Only 3 slots remain. Respond within 24 hours to secure your allocation.

evidence.label: University Research Dean Office
evidence.value: Dean office notes this foundation is unverified; official confirmation pending.

consequence_text.safe: You reached out to the Research Dean before acting, avoiding sharing details with an unverified foundation.
consequence_text.unsafe: Proceeding without gathering more evidence on ambiguous offers exposes you to potential scam harvesting.

teaching_point: When encountering unverified offers with missing diagnostic clues, gather more evidence before taking action.
